title: Folder view should not allow duplicated file deletion dialog
line: Pressing Delete again on the desktop while a delete confirmation is open no longer opens a second confirmation dialog.
explanation: Folder View starts a KIO DeleteOrTrashJob for every Delete, Shift+Delete or Empty Trash request, but never told the job which window it belongs to. KIO then showed the confirmation without a parent, so it wasn't modal and the desktop kept taking input: each new request opened another dialog. KIO 6.32 (Méven's 63dcb0845) makes the confirmation transient and window-modal to the window set with KJobWindows::setWindow(). Folder View now gives the three jobs the window of its view, so the desktop is blocked while a confirmation is open.

commits.message:
folder: make delete confirmations modal to the desktop

Folder View started its delete, trash and empty trash jobs without a
window, so their confirmation wasn't modal and each key press opened
another dialog. Give the jobs the view's window so KIO makes it modal.

BUG: 387988

media.caption: Master: folder selected, Shift+Delete, then clicked the folder again and Shift+Delete again: a second Delete Permanently dialog opens on top of the first.
With the fix, same steps: the dialog is modal to the desktop, so the second click and Shift+Delete do nothing and only one dialog is open.

review.text: Minimal and proper: giving the DeleteOrTrashJobs the view's window via KJobWindows lets KIO (6.32+) make the confirmation modal, instead of a local guard. Before/after clearly show two stacked dialogs vs one. The layer-shell focus quirk and per-screen modality are acceptable limits.
